Mr Ghost: Trick or treat mister!
They are kinda tall. Kids these days grow up so fast!
You: Hi! Are you having fun kids?
Baseball player: Oh yeah. A lot fun. {{wi}}Mister.
You: Hm? Ok. That’s good to hear.
These kids seem kinda rude.
Death: Stop wasting our time old man, do you have any sweets or not?
